name: Flowchart
when_to_pick: Visualize a decision tree or branching process with 4-15 nodes. Best for 'how do you decide X' content where the reader benefits from following arrows. Use classDef accept/reject/warn (defined as 8-digit hex fills, never rgba) to highlight terminal nodes.

source.description: Raw mermaid source starting with 'flowchart TD' or similar. NEVER use rgba(R,G,B,A) inside classDef or style — use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA).
